title: New Hire Laptop Setup
text: New employees pick up their machine from the IT desk on day one and sign in with the temporary credentials mailed to their manager.

title: Getting Your Workstation
text: Fresh joiners collect company hardware during their first week, then complete device enrollment before accessing internal systems.

title: Paid Time Off
text: Full-time staff accrue fifteen days of paid leave per year, and unused days roll over up to a maximum of five.

title: Requesting Vacation
text: Submit time-away requests at least two weeks ahead through the HR portal so your manager can approve them before the calendar locks.

title: Travel Expense Limits
text: Meals are reimbursed up to 60 USD per day on domestic trips, and receipts must be attached within thirty days of the trip.

title: Filing a Reimbursement
text: Upload your receipts to the finance tool and the money lands in your next payroll cycle once your manager signs off.

title: Remote Network Access
text: Connecting from outside the office requires the corporate VPN client with multi-factor authentication enabled on your account.

title: Account Lockout
text: After five failed sign-in attempts the account locks for thirty minutes; the service desk can clear the lock immediately on request.

title: Error DB-5012
text: Error code DB-5012 means the connection pool is exhausted and the service should be restarted after raising the pool size.

title: Error DB-5013
text: Error code DB-5013 means a query exceeded the statement timeout and was cancelled by the database server.

title: On-Call Rotation
text: Engineers take one week of primary on-call every six weeks, with a secondary responder available for escalations after ten minutes.

title: Postmortem Process
text: Every customer-facing outage gets a blameless write-up within five business days that records the timeline, impact and follow-up actions.
